notes: DeepSeek Harness /goal creates one armed persisted same-session objective. This fixture requires exactly two such rounds, one durable create mutation, one durable complete mutation, and no approval request. The first inter-round ready hold lasted 2032 ms, so the prior terminal-ready phase matched it and failed its 10000 ms hold before it could reach the real terminal ready transition. The corrected phases name the inter-round ready and second working transitions explicitly, then anchor termination after round 2. Transcript assertions still prove that both later transitions are autonomous goal rounds and not driver prompts.
